dataset.name: cdc9k
dataset.citation: CDC Diabetes Health Indicators (2017). UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C53919

split.site_assignment: round-robin per class on training rows; unchanged campaign_split

privacy.bounds_policy: Fixed public domain bounds and cuts; frozen before scoring; see trees/README.md
privacy.randomness: Node-owned sticky secret RNG; fresh persistent secret files per site/replicate; not seeded by analyst
privacy.native_clip_semantics: Unit bounded statistics on public feature/target domains; clipping_norm=1 is the node pin, not a DP-SGD forest mechanism
privacy.reported_configuration: See every replicate's node_privacy; native accounting is separately labelled public recomputation

central_configuration.accounting_source: Recomputed from installed, unmodified dsFlower forest_accounting.py; public inputs only

diagnostic.criterion: mean fed AUC > 0.5 AND mean fed accuracy > mean majority-class accuracy
diagnostic.alternative: If either primary epsilon-8 diagnostic fails, run only random_forest cdc45k epsilon 8 with three registered seeds
diagnostic.utility_floor: mean fed accuracy >= mean trivial accuracy - 0.02 OR mean fed AUC > 0.6
